# Recovery and budgets

Proves inspectable type and syntax recovery together with deterministic graph
depth truncation pressure on a recursive advanced type.

The three selected facts also pin the current OXC parser-panic boundary as
three expected `oxc-parse-error` mapping classifications. They remain visible
individually in the conformance report and any change to that classification
fails the gate until the fixture expectation is reviewed.

Each manifest entry also pins `oxc-occurrence-mapping` as owner and an
actionable condition for reclassification: OXC must parse or recover the file
and produce the exact `NodeId` for that selection. A different diagnostic,
candidate state, or mapping outcome is unexplained and CI-blocking.
